description: Fictional circular requires a 30-day policy review after any publication; POL-004 §7.3 already requires exactly that.

extraction.summary: Stock brokers must assess applicability of each publication within 7 working days, amend affected policies within 30 calendar days or by the effective date, and keep a record of each review.

obligations.requirement: Assess and record the applicability of each SEBI or exchange publication within 7 working days.

evidence.text: Every stock broker shall assess the applicability of each SEBI or exchange publication and record the assessment within 7 working days of publication.

obligations.requirement: Review and amend affected internal policies within 30 calendar days of publication or by the effective date, whichever is earlier.

evidence.text: Internal policies and procedures affected by a publication shall be reviewed and, where required, amended within 30 calendar days of the publication date, or by the effective date stated in the publication, whichever is earlier.

obligations.requirement: Maintain a record of each review citing the regulatory provision and affected document.

evidence.text: A record of each such review, citing the regulatory provision and the affected internal document, shall be maintained and made available to the stock exchange on request.

impact.reason: Acme is a stock broker. POL-004 §7.2 records applicability within 5 working days (stricter than 7), §7.3 requires amendment within 30 calendar days or by the effective date, and §7.4 records each review as a compliance review issue citing both clauses — meeting every obligation.

regulatory_evidence.text: amended within 30 calendar days of the publication date, or by the effective date stated in the publication, whichever is earlier

policy_evidence.text: Affected Documents shall be reviewed and, where required, amended within **30 calendar days** of the publication date, or by the effective date stated in the publication, whichever is earlier.
compliance shall record within 5 working days whether it is applicable to Acme and which documents are affected.

impact.recommended_action: No change required; log the review.
